summary: Keep the uploaded documents and stored text only as long as the engagement needs them. A common starting point is to set the date a few months after the engagement ends, and to shorten it when you can.
basis: GDPR, Article 5(1)(e) (storage limitation): personal data must not be kept longer than necessary for the purpose.
Swedish rules on accounting records (Bokföringslagen) set longer periods for bookkeeping material. They apply to the originals you keep elsewhere, not automatically to the copies uploaded here.
caveats: Placeholder, not legal advice, and not reviewed by a data protection specialist.
Confirm the period with your data protection officer before real use.
